faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Assistant position at IIT Jammu?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Research Assistant position at IIT Jammu is 17th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Tech/M.E./M.Sc. degree with at least 60% marks or a Ph.D. in relevant engineering or science disciplines, along with a B.Tech/B.E./B.Sc. degree. Specific disciplines are mentioned in the detailed advertisement.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, six years of experience in Research and Development (R&D) in industrial or academic institutions, S&T organizations, or in scientific activities and services is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Assistant position is 37 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of ₹67,000 per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Research Assistant position at IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official application portal of IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q8. Is a GATE score mandatory for applying?
faq.answer: A valid GATE score is preferred but not explicitly stated as mandatory in the summary. It is advisable to check the official notification for precise requirements.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an interview, which can be conducted online or offline.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article. Please refer to the provided links for detailed information and application submission.
